observations: A single solar panel with a white aluminum frame.
The panel contains 72 monocrystalline cells arranged in a 6x12 grid.
Cells have the characteristic clipped corners of monocrystalline silicon.
A watermark 'YOUNG MIRACLE GLOBAL LINK' is overlaid on the center.
The bottom left shows a camera watermark 'Infinix HOT 30i'.
The background shows cardboard boxes, one with a banana illustration and another with technical specs for a different product (size 607x540x290mm).
No manufacturer label or brand logo is visible on the front of the panel.

claims.evidence: The specification label on the back is not shown.
Photo 0 shows a 6 by 12 grid of cells.
No Jinko branding or logo is visible in the photo.
The clipped corners of the cells in photo 0 are typical of monocrystalline panels.

risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturer's specification label on the back of the panel.
High-resolution close-up photos of the cells or an electroluminescence (EL) test image.
risks.if_unproven: as a used panel with significant efficiency loss

risks.risk: Condition of the junction box and cables
risks.proof: Photo of the rear of the panel showing the junction box and MC4 connectors.
risks.if_unproven: as having damaged or missing connectors

proof_requests: Photo of the specification label on the back of the panel.
Photo of the back of the panel showing the junction box and wiring.
Close-up photo of the panel surface to check for glass scratches or cell defects.
response.reason: The brand and wattage are the primary value drivers for solar panels and cannot be verified without a photo of the manufacturer's label on the back.
